title: Anchorage expands institutional custody to Etherlink, tokenized uranium

title: Coinbase faces greater fallout from CLARITY Act setback: Saxo
summary: A strategist at the Danish bank said Coinbase has more at stake in the CLARITY setback because its trading business is directly exposed to US market-structure rules.

title: Bank of Canada Troubled by High Gas Prices, Warns of Hike Risk
summary: The Bank of Canada’s governing council warned that it may need to hike interest rates, saying the longer gasoline prices remain elevated, the more likely that would pass through to other goods and services.

title: Stocks, Bonds Rise in Countdown to Fed Decision: Markets Wrap
